subject.title: Add external event hooks for quota and provider state changes

question: Should CodexBar permanently support opt-in user-configured local commands through this six-event hook, config, and CLI contract?
rationale: Correctness and containment can be reviewed mechanically, but accepting local process execution and stable external payload semantics requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Approve after account fix
options.body: Accept the hook surface after account-scoped baselines and cross-account regression coverage are added.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Keep the event engine but reduce the initial settings, CLI, or payload contract before committing to long-term compatibility.

options.title: Decline command hooks
options.body: Keep CodexBar observation-only and close the paired feature direction despite the implementation quality.

recommendation.title: Approve after account fix
recommendation.body: Accept the hook surface after account-scoped baselines and cross-account regression coverage are added.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, steipete is the clearest available authority for accepting a permanent product and security boundary.
